ARCHAEOLOGY CATALOGUE · ROW BA-096 Gospel textual transmission
What it supports. The Vatican Library publishes transcription and images of Luke11 and John1 in Bodmer XIV-XV, P75; Bodmer's foundation separately identifies P66 as John.
What it does not. The sampled pages verify textual witnesses, not every Bodmer papyrus or the historicity of the Gospel events; paleographic dates are estimates.
Bears on: Luke, John and other biblical books
